an1.140:1.1: XI. Ye te bhikkhave bhikkhū adhammaṃ adhammo ti dīpenti te bhikkhave bhikkhū bahujanahitāya paṭipannā bahujanasukhāya bahuno janassa atthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanussānaṃ bahuñ ca te bhikkhave bhikkhū puññaṃ pasavanti te c' imaṃ saddhammaṃ ṭhapentī ti. Ye te bhikkhave
an1.142-149:1.1: Ye te bhikkhave bhikkhū avinayaṃ avinayo ti dīpenti . . . pe . . . Ye te bhikkhave bhikkhū vinayaṃ vinayo ti dīpenti . . . pe . . . Ye te bhikkhave bhikkhū abhāsitaṃ alapitaṃ Tathāgatena abhāsitaṃ alapitaṃ Tathāgatenā ti dīpenti . . . pe . . . Ye te bhikkhave bhikkhū bhāsitaṃ lapitaṃ Tathāgatena bhāsitaṃ lapitaṃ Tathāgatenā ti dīpenti . . . pe . . . Ye te bhikkhave bhikkhū anāciṇṇaṃ Tathāgatena anāciṇṇaṃ Tathāgatenā ti dīpenti . . . pe . . . Ye te bhikkhave bhikkhū āciṇṇaṃ Tathāgatena āciṇṇaṃ Tathāgatenā ti dīpenti . . . pe . . . Ye te bhikkhave bhikkhū appaññattaṃ Tathāgatena appaññattaṃ Tathāgatenā ti dīpenti . . . pe . . . Ye te bhikkhave bhikkhū paññattaṃ Tathāgatena paññattaṃ Tathāgatenā ti dīpenti te bhikkhave bhikkhū bahujanahitāya paṭipannā bahujanasukhāya bahuno janassa atthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanussānaṃ bahuñ ca te bhikkhave bhikkhū puññaṃ pasavanti te c' imaṃ saddhammaṃ ṭhapentīti. Ekādasamo
